_comment: Cheats (CheatingManager). context: where it's offered. ok/caught: suspicion if it works / if he sees. 'caught' also confiscates and costs your turn where that makes sense. Doing one while he's watching gets you caught; while he's looking away it works; in the moment he's turning back (his cage shudders) it's a coin toss.

palm_rats.name: PALM SOME TEETH
palm_rats.desc: Two Teeth off the house pile.

pick_pocket.name: PICK A POCKET
pick_pocket.desc: Take an item or three Teeth from someone.

nudge.name: NUDGE YOUR PUPPET
nudge.desc: Your puppet moves on a square while nobody's looking.

shove.name: SHOVE THEIR PUPPET
shove.desc: Someone else's puppet goes back two squares.

peek_gun.name: PEEK AT THE CYLINDER
peek_gun.desc: See whether the next chamber is loaded.

spin_gun.name: SPIN IT SECRETLY
spin_gun.desc: Re-spin the cylinder, without anyone seeing.

shoplift.name: SHOPLIFT
shoplift.desc: Pocket something off the black market's shelf.

game_cheat.name: CHEAT
game_cheat.desc: Whatever this game lets you get away with.
